opening.argument: The video opens as a market update addressing current news and price developments, then examines an alleged DeFi theft and the movement of funds. It also warns viewers about fake or attention-generating information and urges caution when trading with high volume. The separate affiliate promotion does require viewers to sign up through a specified link and pay 100 euros in exchange for a stated reward, but the description expressly identifies the links as affiliate links that may contain advertising supporting the channel. On the available evidence, that disclosure is present, while deceptive terms or behavior are not established.
